title: When Is Additional Retrieval Worthwhile? A Cost-Aware Study of Evidence Gain and Answer Reliability in RAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.37358v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can benefit from more sophisticated retrieval, but extra retrieval may be unnecessary for many questions and gains in evidence retrieval may not translate into faithful or correct answers. We study a cost-aware, two-action retrieval policy that chooses between a dense-retrieval-plus-reranking baseline and a hybrid lexical--dense retriever. Rather than classifying baseline retrieval as simply successful or unsuccessful, we estimate the question-specific incremental evidence-retrieval benefit of hybrid retrieval using features available before the routing decision. A regularized linear model and decision threshold are selected using document-grouped cross-validation and frozen prior to held-out evaluation. translated_title: 何时值得额外检索？RAG中证据增益与答案可靠性的成本感知研究
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）可以从更复杂的检索中受益，但对许多问题而言，额外的检索可能是不必要的，而且证据检索上的收益也不一定能转化为忠实或正确的答案。我们研究了一种成本感知的双动作检索策略，在“稠密检索加重排序”基线与“词汇-稠密混合检索器”之间进行选择。与简单地将基线检索归类为成功或失败不同，我们利用路由决策之前即可获得的特征，估计混合检索针对特定问题的增量证据检索收益。正则化线性模型与决策阈值通过按文档分组的交叉验证进行选择，并在留出集评估之前冻结。在60篇此前未见的QASPER训练集划分文章上（188个问题，其中169个可进行证据评估），该策略在46个问题（24.5%）上触发了混合检索，并获得了与……相同的证据Hit@10（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种成本感知的检索路由策略，通过在路由前预估混合检索相对于稠密检索基线的问题级增量证据收益，仅在约四分之一的问题上触发更昂贵的混合检索，在保持相同证据Hit@10的同时显著降低检索成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cost-aware two-action retrieval routing policy that estimates the question-specific incremental evidence gain of hybrid retrieval over a dense-retrieval-plus-reranking baseline using pre-routing features, triggering hybrid retrieval on only about 25% of questions while achieving the same evidence Hit@10, thereby cutting retrieval cost without sacrificing retrieval quality.
